event_detail: Drawer: the empty gripper hovers at the left corner next to the tall cabinet, making small motions for 4.8 s, without grasping any drawer handle; the drawers stay closed.
evidence: Shoulder views show the drawer fronts along the counter flush with their handles in place (closed) in all four frames, and the arm in nearly the same pose at the left corner, gripper pointed at the tall cabinet. The wrist camera only shows a gray cabinet panel and the wooden floor, no open drawer interior and no straw; the gripper holds nothing. No glass with a straw is visible. A drawer outside the camera views could in principle be open, so confidence is moderate.
